title: A slow speaker (speed 0.75) with long clauses and mid-turn pauses

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Hello, you're through to the helpline. How can I help you today?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hello there, I would like to ask about the appointment I have next month, <1.4s> because I may need to change it.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Of course. Take your time and tell me what you would like to change.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Well, <1.2s> the date is fine, <1.6s> but the time is a little too early for me.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: I understand. The same day has a later slot at half past two. Would that be better?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Half past two <1.3s> would be much better, <1.5s> thank you.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: I have moved it to half past two on the same day. A new confirmation will come to you by post and by email. Is there anything else?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: No, that is all. Thank you very much. Goodbye.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Goodbye, and thank you for calling.
